entities.name: uL16m
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Homo sapiens UniProt Q9NX20; 251 aa and 100% identity/coverage.
Mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit protein; component of the 39S mt-LSU.
Binds mitochondrial rRNA and contributes structural support to the ribosome.
N-terminal region is rich in Arg/Lys and compatible with mitochondrial targeting; the mature protein is expected to reside in the mitochondrial ribosome.
Pfam Ribosomal_L16 domain PF00252.25 spans residues 61–190.
No explicit catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved; function is structural/rRNA-binding rather than enzymatic.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass about 28.45 kDa; theoretical pI 10.13; predicted net charge at pH 7 about +16.

entities.name: Q9NX20
observations: Reviewed human reference sequence for mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit protein uL16m.
Annotated with mitochondrial localization, mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit membership, rRNA binding, structural constituent of ribosome, and mitochondrial translation.

entities.name: Mitochondrial translation
observations: uL16m is annotated as participating in mitochondrial translation as a component of the 39S mitochondrial ribosomal subunit.
